lines.t: Can I step into Your will
And never leave it?
If my strength is gone
Can You carry me on?
If I take the leap
Will You give me wings?
Lead me, Father, into that place
Where my will dies, and all I see is Your face
I forget my flesh and all troubles melt away
In the light of Your glory, all else fades
I'll leave the world behind
Unshackle the chains that bind
Let Your spirit take over my mind
I'll surrender all, and together we'll fly
Lead me, Father, into that place
Where my will dies, and all I see is Your face
I forget my flesh and all troubles melt away
In the light of Your glory, all else fades
Oh my Treasure, capture my gaze
Cover me in Your love and grace
Hide me in Your strong embrace
YahuShua, lead me to that place
